vocabulary.note_ar: أيام الأسبوع تبدأ دائمًا بحرف كبير
vocabulary.note_en: Days of the week always start with a capital letter.

vocabulary.example: We have English class on Tuesday.
On Friday I visit my parents.
Saturday afternoon I do my errands.
I'll clean the house on Sunday.

vocabulary.note_en: Free can also mean 'costing no money'.

vocabulary.meaning_en: some of the time, not always

vocabulary.note_ar: never معناها منفي، فلا نضع معها not
vocabulary.note_en: Never is already negative; do not add not.
vocabulary.example: I never have time to see a movie.

vocabulary.meaning_en: normal; what happens most of the time
a film you watch on a screen
vocabulary.example: Do you want to see a movie?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a dance where you make sounds with special shoes
vocabulary.example: Anna is learning to tap dance.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a game played with pieces on a special board

vocabulary.example: My father jogs in the park every morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a public green area with grass and trees

vocabulary.example: She teaches children how to read.

vocabulary.meaning_en: young people; more than one child
small jobs like shopping or going to the bank
vocabulary.example: I do my errands on Saturday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the time when it is dark
the time between noon and evening

vocabulary.note_en: in the afternoon / on Saturday afternoon

vocabulary.meaning_en: having great value; you must think about it

fine_lines.title: always vs sometimes vs never
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ظروف التكرار تقول كم مرة نفعل الشيء: always = كل مرة (100%)، sometimes = أحيانًا، never = ولا مرة (0%). ونضعها قبل الفعل العادي وبعد فعل be.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Adverbs of frequency say how often: always = every time, sometimes = some of the time, never = not at any time. Put them before a normal verb and after be.

examples.sentence: I always drink water in the morning.

fine_lines.title: on Friday vs at night vs in the afternoon
fine_lines.explanation_ar: on مع الأيام: on Friday, on Monday night. at مع الساعة وكلمة night: at 6 p.m., at night. in مع أجزاء اليوم: in the morning, in the afternoon.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use on with days (on Friday, on Monday night), at with clock times and night (at 6 p.m., at night), and in with parts of the day (in the morning).

expressions.meaning_en: An informal way to ask 'How are things?'

expressions.example: What's new? - Not much. How about you?
How is work? - Busy as usual.

expressions.meaning_en: Asking if someone has time on a day.
expressions.example: Are you free on Friday? Let's visit the museum.

expressions.meaning_en: Said when you stop to think or check.
expressions.example: Let's see ... yes, I'm free at five.
We're going to the beach. - That sounds fun!
Eat vegetables. They are good for you.
I'm busy on Tuesday. How about on Wednesday?

expressions.meaning_en: Stop for a moment (often because you have an idea).
expressions.example: Wait a minute. Are you free now?
The bus is here. Let's go!

grammar.title: Adverbs of frequency: always, sometimes, never
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) ظرف التكرار يقول كم مرة يحدث الشيء. 2) نضعه قبل الفعل العادي: I always jog. 3) ونضعه بعد فعل be: She is always busy. 4) never منفية بنفسها: I never jog (وليس I don't never jog). 5) sometimes يمكن أن تأتي في أول الجملة أيضًا.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Adverbs of frequency say how often something happens. 2) Put them before a normal verb: I always jog. 3) Put them after be: She is always busy. 4) Never is negative already: I never jog (not I don't never jog). 5) Sometimes can also start a sentence.
examples: I never have time to see a movie.
Saturday afternoon is always when I do my errands.

grammar.title: Talking about plans: be + verb-ing and going to
grammar.explanation_ar: للحديث عن خطة مرتّبة في المستقبل نستخدم المضارع المستمر مع وقت مستقبلي: I'm teaching on Wednesday. أو be going to + فعل: I am going to jog on Monday.
grammar.explanation_en: For a planned future activity, use the present continuous with a future time (I'm teaching on Wednesday) or be going to + verb (I'm going to jog on Monday).
examples: I'm going to tap dance with my friends Thursday night.
What are you doing on Wednesday?
I'm going to visit my grandmother on Friday.

grammar.title: Prepositions of time: on, at, in
grammar.explanation_ar: on + يوم: on Friday, on Monday night. at + ساعة: at 6 p.m.، at night. in + جزء من اليوم أو شهر: in the morning, in July.
grammar.explanation_en: on + day: on Friday, on Monday night. at + clock time: at 6 p.m., at night. in + part of the day or month: in the morning, in July.
examples: Are you busy this Thursday at 6 p.m.?
I do my homework in the evening.

questions.question: 'I never jog' means:
choices: I don't jog at any time.
questions.explanation_en: Never means not at any time.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation_en: With be, the adverb comes after it.

questions.explanation_ar: للخطة المستقبلية: am going to + فعل.

questions.explanation_ar: What's going on? سؤال عن الأخبار، والجواب: Not much.

questions.question: Which word means 'some of the time'?
questions.explanation_en: Sometimes means some of the time.
